content.title: The distance from Makkah to Madinah is 400 KM
content.subtitle: O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, how did you cross this scorching, perilous desert?
content.body:
From Makkah to Madinah—a journey of more than 400 kilometers.

How did you cross this scorching, perilous desert with just one companion, O Messenger of Allah ﷺ?

I often find myself wondering.

Behind you was the beloved land of your birth.
Ahead lay an unknown path.
All around you, an endless desert. And above you, the blazing sky.

O Messenger of Allah ﷺ, when you left Makkah that night—what was going through your heart?

This was the city where you were born.
Where you spent your childhood.
Where the people you loved lived.

Yet you had to leave it all behind.

Your home.
Your city.
Your loved ones.
Your familiar life.

For one reason, dear reader—

So that, by the will of Allah, His Deen could reach you and me.

So that, centuries later, you and I could say:

La ilaha illallah!

So that we could know Allah.
Worship Him.
And walk the path that leads to Jannah.

Just think—

The one who left his homeland for us…
Have we kept enough love in our hearts to hold on to the path he showed us?

We say,

“I love the Messenger of Allah ﷺ.”

But if we had to prove that love today, what would we do?

Perhaps it doesn't have to be something extraordinary.

The proof of loving the Prophet ﷺ is to follow the path he showed us—to hold firmly to his Sunnah.

It could be using the miswak.
Following a Sunnah before going to sleep.
Giving full measure and weight.
Staying away from bribery and interest.
And so much more.

Whenever you do something taught by the Prophet ﷺ, pause for a moment and remind yourself:

“My beloved Prophet ﷺ used to do it this way.
So I will do it this way too.”

Perhaps that is how love stops being merely a feeling in the heart—

and becomes a part of our lives.

At Muslims Day, we want to keep reminding people of this love every single day and help these reminders reach more hearts.

You can be a part of this journey too. Share these reminders with the people you know. Perhaps they will touch someone's heart and inspire them to follow the Sunnah.

And through the good deeds that follow, your contribution may become a means of salvation for you too, InshaAllah.
